headline: SK Hynix pulls Solidigm IPO, citing market volatility
body: SK Hynix said it is pulling an IPO for its U.S.-based Solidigm unit, citing market volatility. SK Hynix said in a release that the review was discontinued in light of market conditions and share price trends.
note: The cancelled listing shows an AI-linked offering can be pulled when markets turn, even for a unit of one of the sector's biggest winners.

evidence.text: On Thursday, South Korean memory giant SK Hynix , one of the biggest winners in the AI boom, said it's pulling an IPO for its U.S.-based Solidigm unit, citing market volatility.

"While an IPO was expected to ease investment burdens and expand capacity for shareholder returns, the review has been discontinued in light of market conditions and share price trends," SK Hynix said in a release .
